title: Reflect AI showcase
description: A centred badge, gradient heading and three-line lead, then a translucent note card in a double hairline frame floating in a beam of violet light, with a shimmering hue-cycling 'magic' link and light streaks running along its edges; below, a 32px sub-heading and a hairline-ruled list of capabilities, three across and two centred under them, each with a line icon and two lines of text that catch a soft light on hover. On phones the list is one left-aligned column on a left rule and the magic link shrinks to an icon button in the card's corner.
notes: media is the beam-and-floor image behind the card (1440×835); empty, it is a glow wash that fades in on entering view
items 1–3 make the top row, the rest are centred under them
